origin: right-hand grip point (where prop.R holds it)
barrel: Blender -Y = Godot +Z (in the weapon file local space). Once attached, the bore follows the character facing in aim clips.
attach_to_prop_R: identity: BoneAttachment3D(bone_name="prop.R") on the astronaut Skeleton3D, weapon scene as its child with Transform3D.IDENTITY (position 0,0,0, rotation 0,0,0, scale 1)

children.Mag: removable energy cell mesh (hide/show or reparent during rifle_reload); local centre Godot [0, 0.007, -0.135]
children.Muzzle: empty at the barrel tip: local Godot [0, 0.092, 0.566] (spawn muzzle flash / start of the hitscan ray here; ray direction = Muzzle global basis +Z, or the camera ray)
children.Grip_L: empty at the foregrip: local Godot [0, -0.005, 0.195]

notes: bullpup layout; cell inserts behind the grip, matching rifle_reload contact frames
Designed slightly long (0.91 m incl. emitter) for third-person readability.
